name: Danger, Flavor, Bizarre Summer!
source:
One summer day, a bizarre turn of events befalls a group of friends in Center City. As Chipp, the player must make choices which will lead to one of multiple endings in this short story. This game was created for the Robot Party Jam 2024, hosted by Kyle Bosman.

[Source: https://alexanderarts.itch.io/danger-flavor-bizarre-summer]
